purpose: Check whether the pinned STE-FlowNet photometric objective on fixed ReplicaCAD validation endpoints prefers shared GT flow over zero and reversed flow; no training or checkpoint selection.

model.name: STE-FlowNet
model.inference_input: full-frame event tensor only; model used once only to identify actual four output scales, no prediction is evaluated or trained

data.split_unit: full ReplicaCAD layout family; both rows are pre-existing held-out sc2 validation rollouts
data.event_count_filtering: none; event counts do not select or remove samples
data.gray_endpoints: linear luma 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B from the fixed Genesis radiance source at indices 0 and 3 (0 ms and 30 ms); no gamma or histogram fitting

objective.implementation: pinned STE-FlowNet multiscaleloss.compute_photometric_loss through the benchmark objective_dt1 adapter and align_corners=True compatibility patch
objective.candidates: shared bank GT flow as stored; all-zero flow; negative GT flow
objective.scale_flow_conversion: bilinear resize with align_corners=False; multiply u by scale_width/full_width and v by scale_height/full_height, matching the existing multi-scale supervised helper
objective.photometric: four scales, official Charbonnier alpha=0.45 epsilon=1e-3, weights [1,1,1,1]; report per-scale values and official mean
objective.full_objective: report official second-order smoothness and photo + 10*smoothness for diagnostic context; do not use it for model/checkpoint selection
objective.warp_contract: shared align_corners=True; match actual training loss; keep zero padding and source warp masks unchanged
objective.ground_truth_validity: not injected into the official photometric objective; report geometric valid mask/coverage separately to avoid altering the training objective

diagnostic_regions.primary_geometry_texture_region: shared flow_valid AND GT magnitude >= 0.5 px/30ms AND luma gradient magnitude > 1/255 at both endpoints AND all three candidate warps remain in-bounds
diagnostic_regions.also_report: valid pixels, joint normal EventGenesis/V2E event-active valid pixels, texture pixels, GT-motion/texture/valid overlap, common in-bounds count and flow-loss in-bounds fractions

execution.device: one GPU only, chosen by current live ownership check plus atomic project UUID reservation
execution.stop_rule: fail on any source/data hash mismatch, label mismatch, nonfinite input/output, unexpected model output scales, or mismatch between official scalar photometric loss and its per-scale decomposition

limits: Only two pre-existing held-out layout-family rollouts; this tests the photometric objective/data pairing, not downstream model learning or generator quality.
The scalar official loss includes padded and invalid-GT image regions exactly as the pinned implementation does; the separate shared texture/motion region is descriptive.
No real dataset or score is used.
